name: Leyard Optoelectronic Co., Ltd.
summary: Leyard Optoelectronic Co., Ltd. operates as an audio-visual technology company in China and internationally. The company operates through Intelligent Display; Cultural Tourism and Nighttime Entertainment; and AI and Spatial Computing segments. It provides micro and small pitch LED products; AI smart devices; movie screens; commercial displays; project shows; outdoor naked-eye 3D display; indoor rental creative display; virtual shooting; outdoor all-in-one machine; smart meetings; smart education; and supporting equipment.
